name: ostacky
description: Instalador interactivo de agentes y comandos para OpenCode

scripts.prebuild: bun run scripts/sync-version.ts && bun run scripts/sync-controller-core.ts
scripts.build: bun run build:cli && bun run build:mcp
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile dist/cli.js && bun scripts/add-shebang.ts
scripts.hash:update: bun run build:mcp && bun run scripts/update-manifest-hashes.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run hash:update
scripts.update: bun run scripts/check-skill-sync.ts && bun run scripts/sync-controller-core.ts && bun run hash:update
